name: DDRK HC2 and HC3 multistep (full read of hc2_step, extends ddrk-omega)
plain: A one-call multistep solver in the same family as DPM++ 2M and 3M, with guards: the higher-order correction is limited elementwise to the size of the first-order move. HC3 adds a trust factor that shrinks the extrapolation when consecutive slopes disagree, and a free UniC-like correction of the previous step after the next model call. The code comments report a bench on an analytic mixture, not on images.
math:
λ=−log σ (EDM) or log((1−σ)/σ) (flow). h=λ_next−λ; α=1 EDM, 1−σ_next flow.
First order F=(1−e^(−h))(D−x) EDM, (1−σ_next/σ)(D−x) flow.
r=(D−D₋₁)/h₋₁. c₂=r α(h−1+e^(−h)).
Order 3 if history and ratio |c₃|/|c₂|<1, dd=(r−r₋₁)/(h₋₁+h₋₂): c₃=dd α(h²−2h+2−2e^(−h)+h₋₁(h−1+e^(−h))), clamped to ±|c₂|.
x⁺=x+F+clamp(c₂[+c₃], ±κ|F|). Default order 2, κ=1.
HC3 (hc2_step with damping and free_corrector on): θ=clamp(1−‖r−r₋₁‖/(‖r‖+‖r₋₁‖),0,1), r←θ r, dd←θ²dd.
Free corrector at the next step: x+=α φ₂(h)(D_now−D)/h [+ dd·α(2φ₃(h)−hφ₂(h))] − previous applied correction; skipped if the latent did not arrive by that step.
Optional paid corrector: if activity>corrector_thresh, one extra model call at x⁺.
max_order≥3 bootstraps the first step with Heun.

claims.text: bench: free corrector lowers error 1.3-4x at 20-30 calls on EDM Karras; not validated on images

surprise: The code comments record that AB2 slope extrapolation on top of Heun or RK4 makes them first order, measured on the same bench; it now applies only to Euler.
